summary: Narrow dead-end lane with houses at the kerb and no-stopping signs.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room off lane

best_section.where: Queens Road west kerb near the Hilda Street end of the lane

drivers.seclusion: Mapped houses at 0 m, 7 m and 10 m along the whole stretch, with homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane by the rail corridor; cars park tight to the west kerb, little room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Low traffic, but the rail line is just north so train noise is likely.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the lane, but No Stopping signs cover the kerb.

flags: No Stopping signs along this kerb
sun_shade: Open lane; houses and trees on the east side shade it in the afternoon.
